chunks: That salat (prayer) is not performed in al-Baydāʾ, Dhāt al-Ṣalāṣil, the valley of al-Shuqrah, nor in the valley of Ḍajnān.

key_terms.الْبَيْدَاءِ: al-Baydāʾ, a specific location mentioned as unsuitable for prayer
key_terms.ذَاتِ الصَّلَاصِلِ: Dhāt al-Ṣalāṣil, a named place where prayer is not to be performed
key_terms.وَادِي الشُّقْرَةِ: the valley of al-Shuqrah, a specified valley mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.وَادِي ضَجْنَانَ: the valley of Ḍajnān, another specified valley mentioned in the ruling

ai.seo_question: In which places should salat (prayer) not be performed according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling concerning places in which salat (prayer) should not be performed. It identifies specific locations that are to be avoided for prayer, reflecting jurisprudential guidance on valid and unsuitable places of worship.
